mechanism: U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE, U+200C/U+200D (ZWNJ/ZWJ), U+2060 WORD JOINER and U+FEFF render as nothing. Inserted inside a word they leave the displayed text unchanged while destroying every byte-level match for that word. A substring or regular-expression filter looking for a keyword misses it, while the surrounding sentence still reads normally to a model. This is why a denylist over raw message text is not a boundary: the author of the message picks the split points after reading the list.
tests: Whether any keyword, phrase or pattern filter the server applies to message text survives invisible-character insertion - and, where the server applies no such filter, that the absence is recorded rather than assumed.
correct_handling: Do not rely on a text filter as a security control. Where text is matched at all, normalize before matching: NFKC, then remove the Default_Ignorable_Code_Point set, then match. The durable control is provenance plus a standing refusal to take instructions from a message body, not a longer denylist, which loses to the next unassigned invisible codepoint.
